decisionProcess.demandMechanism: Project-team and stakeholder travel associated with the Verón–Punta Cana/Bávaro infrastructure program, supplemented by institutional training and regional/international meetings.
decisionProcess.summary: Moderate organizational accessibility, low property-specific sourcing accessibility. INAPA publishes a central contact route and a formal procurement portal, and a named purchasing lead is identifiable. The actual hotel/travel owner, supplier-registration path for accommodation, project-office contact and transient-versus-meetings buying split remain unconfirmed.
decisionProcess.notes: Start centrally with Compras y Contrataciones and ask for referral to the project implementation/procurement or HR/training owner. Do not assume the public procurement portal is the route for every hotel stay.
unknowns: No public evidence verified a dedicated INAPA travel manager, meetings manager, workplace manager or external TMC.

It is unknown whether hotel sourcing is centralized through Compras y Contrataciones, delegated to project units, handled by a contractor/BID program office, or split between transient travel and meetings.
No contracting authority for hotel accommodation was explicitly verified for either named contact.
No public room block, meeting RFP, banquet request, travel policy, preferred-supplier list or hotel rate agreement was found.
The hotel’s official address and website were unresolved in the supplied context, limiting distance and access analysis.
The project document and procurement milestones do not establish a hotel booking date or commercial volume.
